player_prompt.intro:
Uwewe ni Umukino {player_id} mu mukino wa Poker ya Indian.
- 52-card deck; uwewe wona kabisa umukino wa mukerarugendo.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) buri round, {max_rounds} round(s) yose.
- Ikintu gikora: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari nziza <= chip ziduweho).
- Umukino wera ushobora kufunga pot ku kiganiro.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Tanga ikintu kimwe gusa kilichogatishwa, kama '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', cyangwa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Umubare w'amafaranga yishyurwa / yo kuzamura ugomba kuba ≥ 1.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Koresha [bet X] kugirango ufungure; nta kubeshya gukura.
invalid_move.insufficient: Nta biceri bihagije byo gukoresha muri icyo gikorwa.

message.showdown_tie: Gushyira hamwe: bombi {card}. Igikombe cyasatswe buri wese ahabwa {split} .
